about: Golden questions for the CreditLens AI retrieval eval (milestone 5). A question is answered correctly when the retriever returns a chunk whose heading path contains `expected_section`, or whose text contains `expected_rule_id`. Questions are written the way Priya, a credit analyst, would actually type them: no copied phrases from the manual, because a retriever that only works on copied phrases is not a retriever.
scoring: recall@k and MRR, per retriever (vector, bm25, hybrid, reranked). See evals/retrieval_eval.py.

corpora.good_bank_policy: data/raw/policy/credit_policy_manual.md (fictional Good Bank manual, sections 1 to 9)
corpora.sba_sop: data/real/sba_sop_50_10.md (real SBA SOP 50 10 rulebook, public domain)

questions.question: How long must a business have been trading before Good Bank will lend to it?
Which industries will Good Bank not lend to at all?
What is the minimum debt service coverage ratio and how is it calculated?
How much leverage is allowed, measured as total borrowings against EBITDA?
Is there a floor on the current ratio, and which liabilities go into it?
How many bounced cheques in a year are acceptable on the operating account?
What share of money coming into the account may be cash deposits?
When do two companies count as part of the same group?
What is the cap on total lending across all the companies in one group?
Do I still have to list related companies in the memo when we are under the limit?
What is the longest tenure we can offer on a working capital facility?
Does the managing director have to stand behind the loan personally?
What do I have to do before a file with a breach goes to the underwriter?
Can an analyst sign off a waiver on a deal they are handling themselves?
Am I allowed to paste a borrower's PAN and phone number into an AI tool?
Can I open a file that belongs to another region?
In what order should the sections of the credit memo appear?
Is a petrol station operating under a fuel supply or dealer agreement treated as a franchise?
How does the lender work out whether the applicant counts as a small business, and at what date?
Can a company whose main business is making loans to others get an SBA guarantee?
Does every owner and guarantor have to be a United States citizen or national?
Must the lender screen the business and its owners against the sanctions lists?
If the borrower buys a building with the loan, how much of it may be rented out to other tenants?
What checks are needed when the project involves a building on the National Register of Historic Places?
How long can a 7(a) loan run for, and what decides the term?
Can a 7(a) loan carry a floating rate, and who sets the ceiling on it?
What security does the lender have to take on a 7(a) loan?
Can SBA help finance a purchase by an employee stock ownership plan?
questions.expected_section: Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs)

questions.question: What insurance does the lender have to put in place on the collateral?
